item.text: {"answers":[{"question_id":"Q014_paper_example_reclassification_pa1492","answer":"In SCOP 1.69, PA1492 from Pseudomonas aeruginosa, PDB 1t1j chain A, was not classified with nucleoside 2-deoxyribosyltransferase from 1f8y chain A except at the broad class level. The 1t1j domain d1t1ja_ was in its own PA1492 fold, superfamily, and family: c.137, Hypothetical protein PA1492; c.137.1, Hypothetical protein PA1492; c.137.1.1, Hypothetical protein PA1492. The 1f8y domain d1f8ya_ was in the Flavodoxin-like fold c.23, the N-deoxyribosyltransferase superfamily c.23.14, and the N-deoxyribosyltransferase family c.23.14.1. In the current SCOPe release 2.08, the PA1492 domain is d1t1ja1, residues A:1-118, and it has been moved into the same Flavodoxin-like fold and the same N-(deoxy)ribosyltransferase-like superfamily as 1f8y: d1t1ja1 is c.23.14.2, Hypothetical protein PA1492, while d1f8ya_ remains c.23.14.1, N-deoxyribosyltransferase. Thus the Andreeva et al. reclassification changed the relationship from no fold/superfamily relationship in SCOP 1.69 to common fold and superfamily membership in SCOPe 2.08, but not to the same family; the classification supports remote homology at the c.23.14 superfamily level, not direct transfer of the 1f8y family assignment or nucleoside 2-deoxyribosyltransferase activity to PA1492.","evidence_used":["mcp__scope.get_scop_chain: /api/v1/releases/1.69/chains/1t1jA; /api/v1/releases/2.08/chains/1t1jA; /api/v1/releases/2.08/chains/1f8yA","mcp__scope.get_scop_domains: /api/v1/releases/1.69/sids/d1t1ja_; /api/v1/releases/1.69/sids/d1t1ja_/parents; /api/v1/releases/1.69/sids/d1f8ya_; /api/v1/releases/1.69/sids/d1f8ya_/parents; /api/v1/releases/current; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1t1ja1; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1t1ja1/parents; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1f8ya_; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1f8ya_/parents"]}]}
